knownGaps.title: Complete absence of automated test suite and test harness (SPEC Q1 violation)
knownGaps.description: SPEC.md Q1 mandates that unit tests must exist for every requirement under S (S1–S7), C (C1–C2), and T (T1–T3). However, no test directories (e.g. test/, tests/, __tests__) or test files (*.test.ts, *.spec.ts) exist in the repository. package.json specifies no test runner dependencies (vitest, jest, mocha, etc.) or test scripts.

knownGaps.title: Public contract field name mismatch in WorkflowTerminalSummary (SPEC T3)
knownGaps.description: SPEC.md T3 explicitly declares that outputRetryAttempts and launchRetryAttempts are public contracts consumed by external tools. In src/workflow-terminal.ts lines 33 and 107, the property is defined and returned as launchRetries rather than launchRetryAttempts. Without automated contract/schema tests, breaking contract regressions cannot be caught.

knownGaps.title: Stop polling interval default and minimum bound discrepancy (SPEC S3)
knownGaps.description: SPEC.md S3 requires a default pollMs of 50ms and a lower bound of not less than 10ms. In src/workflow-stop.ts line 67, the implementation sets Math.max(1, options.pollMs ?? 200), defaulting to 200ms and clamping to a minimum of 1ms. No unit tests or timing validation exists.

knownGaps.title: isWorkflowStopRequestedError uses message matching contrary to spec (SPEC S6)
knownGaps.description: SPEC.md S6 states that isWorkflowStopRequestedError must recognize only errors whose name is WorkflowStopRequested and must not evaluate message contents. In src/workflow-stop.ts lines 56–58, it includes error.message.startsWith('workflow stop requested'). No validation tests exist to safeguard against message-heuristic false positives.

knownGaps.title: Cancellation classification accepts unauthorized provider error values (SPEC C1)
knownGaps.description: SPEC.md C1 dictates that error and reason strings must be strictly limited to 'aborted', 'AbortError', and 'ABORT_ERR', explicitly forbidding promoting other provider errors to cancellations. In src/workflow-cancellation.ts line 20, candidate === 'cancelled' and candidate === 'timeout' are recognized as cancellations. No unit tests verify provider cancellation boundaries.

knownGaps.title: Lack of distribution build, package bundling, or CI validation workflows
knownGaps.description: tsconfig.json has noEmit set to true, package.json lacks build scripts or npm publishing configuration (private: true), and no CI workflow configurations (e.g. .github/workflows) exist in the repository to validate commits automatically.
